description: Add a structural or decorative column at (x, z), or rebuild one by nodeId. Supports native fields or optional code using the same module and conventions as add_object, with floor mount and its bottom centre at the support point. Params named height, width and depth drive the native size controls. Only add columns when requested.

category.description: What this design is, in one or two words.

code.description: A module (three.js, or bpy with language) when the native fields cannot express the column. Same module and conventions as add_object; mount floor. Declare height, width and depth params for editable dimensions.

depth.description: Depth when crossSection is "square" / "rectangular" (default: 0.44). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

description.description: A short description of this design, at most 200 characters.

height.description: Column height (default: 2.5). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

language.description: The code's language: 'three' (default) for a three.js module, 'bpy' for a Blender module (see add_object). On an edit it defaults to the language the object was built in.

level.description: Level id from list_levels; omitted uses the viewed or lowest level.

name.description: What the user would call this design.

nodeId.description: Rebuild this column with code, params or native size fields; get_source provides current code when needed.

params.description: Values for the params the module declares; on an edit, each one you leave out keeps its current value (clamped to the param's range) and a param new to the code starts at its default.

radius.description: Radius when crossSection is "round" (default: 0.22). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

rotation.description: Y-axis rotation (default: 0). In degrees, or text with a unit ("1.57rad").

style.description: Visual style: 'plain' (default smooth pillar), 'faceted' (sharp prism faces), 'fluted' (vertical channels — classical), 'lathe-turned' (turned bands — porch / interior), 'dravidian-carved' (heavy carving — temple), 'cluster' (bundled colonnette — gothic).

tags.description: Up to five short lowercase search tags, at most 32 characters each.

width.description: Width when crossSection is "square" / "rectangular" (default: 0.44). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

x.description: X position of the column center (meters)

y.description: Support point height above the level, in metres (default 0).

z.description: Z position of the column center (meters)

name: add_column
title: Add column
